title: Fragrance safety in focus: IFRA joins the SAAFFI Western Cape Seminar 2026
summary: The International Fragrance Association ( IFRA ) will share the latest on the 52 nd Amendment to the IFRA Standards with the South African flavor and fragrance community at the seminar of the South African Association of the Flavour & Fragrance Industry ( SAAFFI ) on Wednesday, 28 October 2026 .
